name: Seirei Rimu no Love Icha Nakadashi Ongaeshi ~Oppai Monde Maryoku Charge♪ Ecchi na Negai Kanaemasu!~
original_name: 精霊リムのラブイチャ中出し恩返し～おっぱい揉んで魔力チャージ♪エッチな願い叶えます！～
source:
A rare items collector was polishing a lamp when a young girl named Rimu emerged with a magical blast. Eternally grateful for having freed her spirit, she offered to repay his kindness...

Her lifespan however is limited. More than simply saving her, to carry on her mystical powers, she'll need to bear children...

Rimu the beautiful genie is ovulating and wants to make you happy.

All wishes come true in an erotic, magical adventure with Rimu!
